production_rules: Render exactly one 1080x1440 PNG per report so Teams shows one complete page like the approved mockup.
Header, KPI cards, chart block, donut block, detail table and footer must all live on the same page.
Morning and full-day variants share the same visual grammar but may use different decorative header scenes.
Daily table must visually distinguish morning in blue and afternoon in green.
All names, times, durations, totals and statuses come only from the canonical attendance business report.
Missing or unresolved values are never inferred.
No external images, remote fonts, AI-generated text or logo are used in the deterministic renderer.
Teams delivery uses the exact rendered PNG as a native hostedContent and only scales it proportionally.
